rules.name: Excrutia Armatus
rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of this unit do not gain the benefit of the Stubborn special rule.

rules.name: Distort Field
rules.description: While this unit is attached to a friendly unit, wounds may not be allocated to this model and must be allocated to other models first, even if they have the Precision Strikes special rule.

rules.name: Heralding Rider
rules.description: If this unit is alive and, on the Battlefield, friendly units may re-roll the roll when determining if they would arrive via Outflank.

rules.name: Twice Victor of the Blood Games
rules.description: This unit and any attached unit may make a Scout Move as if they had the Scout special rule.

selectionEntries.name: The Captain General of the Ten Thousand

rules.name: The Captain General of the Ten Thousand
rules.description: Any friendly Imperium unit which can draw visibility to this unit adds 1 to the number of wounds inflicted in the Combat Phase for the purposes of combat resolution and determining who won combat.

rules.name: Galatus Shield
rules.description: All charges against a model equipped with this Wargear are considered Disordered Charges. A model this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Void Knights
rules.description: All friendly units within 6” of this unit cannot be targeted by Psychic Powers and or Psychic Weapons. In addition, enemy units within 3” of allied units under this effect do not gain the benefit of Psychic Powers. Only one unit in your army may be upgraded to be Void Knights.

rules.name: Marked for Death
rules.description: At the beginning of the game, during deployment, select a single enemy unit in your opponent’s army. Resolve all attacks against that unit with your equipped Nemesis Boltguns as if your Nemesis Boltguns had the Rending (5+) special rule.

rules.name: Transport
rules.description: This unit can transport 16 Infantry models. It may not transport models with the Bulky (x) special rule.

rules.name: Spectra Distort Shield
rules.description: A unit which includes a model with this wargear may not be targeted for attacks in the Shooting Phase unless it is the closest visible model.

rules.name: Tarsus Buckler
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear has the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule in the Combat Phase.

rules.name: Savage Fighter
rules.description: If this unit includes a Cyber Mastiff, Cyber Falidae or Cyber Caiman, the unit gains the Furious Charge special rule.

rules.name: Relentless Tracker
rules.description: If this unit includes a Cyber Mastiff model, it may move an additional D3” when the unit Advances.

rules.name: Toughened Scale
rules.description: A Cyber Caiman model in this unit gains the benefit of the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule.

rules.name: Raptor Cry
rules.description: If this unit includes a Cyber Raptor, enemy units may not arrive from Outflank within 12” of this unit.

rules.name: Reinforced Atomantic Shielding
rules.description: This confers a 4+ Invulnerable save. When a model with this wargear is slain and removed from play, the model suffers an Explodes result per the Vehicle damage chart before it is removed from play.

rules.name: Transport
rules.description: This model can transport 10 Infantry models. It may also Transport 1 Dreadnought model.

sharedRules.name: Anathema
sharedRules.description:
A unit with this special rule gains the following effects:
• The unit cannot be affected by Psychic powers.
• Units with this special rule cannot be targeted by weapons with the Psychic Weapon special rule.
• Enemy units within 3” do not gain the benefits of any Psychic powers cast on them.
• Units with this special rule may only be joined by units with the Sisters of Silence Keyword.

sharedRules.name: Emperors Own
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule has the Stubborn special rule and automatically Rally at the start of your movement phase. In addition, when a unit with this special rule conducting a Fall Back Move would move off the Battlefield edge, they instead stop 1” away and automatically rally.

sharedRules.name: The Sodality
sharedRules.description: Coherency for units with this special rule is 3” horizontal and 9” vertical instead of 2” horizontal and 6” vertical. In addition, units with this special rule always count as outnumbering enemy models when contesting objectives regardless of the number of enemy models that are actually contesting the objective.

sharedRules.name: Binding
sharedRules.description: When a weapon gets hit with this special rule, it must make a Toughness test. If the test is passed, nothing happens. If the test is failed, the unit that was hit by a weapon with this special rule is automatically Pinned. This does not affect Vehicles, Aircraft, Walker, Titan, or Knight type units.

sharedRules.name: Ex Oblivio
sharedRules.description: Enemy units within 3” of this unit are treated as being -1 Weapon Skill (WS). In addition, all attacks made by this unit in the Combat Phase with Melee type weapons are resolved as if they had the Bane special rule.

rules.name: Vexila Magnifica
rules.description: A model with this wargear and its unit may re-roll failed Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, the unit counts as having scored 1 additional wound in the Combat Phase for the purposes of determining combat resolution.

rules.name: Vexila Defensor
rules.description: A model with this wargear and its unit may Set to Defend even if they make a Shooting Attack in the Shooting Phase. A unit that Sets to Defend treats all Charges against it as being Disordered Charges.

rules.name: Vexila Imperius
rules.description: A model with this Wargear and its unit may Set to Overwatch even if they made a Shooting Attack in the Shooting Phase. All Overwatch attacks made by the unit are resolved as if they have the Gets Hot! Special rule if the unit made a Shooting Attack in its previous Shooting Phase.A model with this wargear and its unit may Set to Defend even if they make a Shooting Attack in the Shooting Phase. A unit that Sets to Defend treats all Charges against it as being Disordered Charges.

rules.name: Aquilon Terminator Armor
rules.description: An ancient heavier pattern of Terminator Armour rarely used. It provides a 2+ Armour save and a 3+ Invulnerable save. The Wearer gains the Relentless, Slow & Purposeful, Bulky (3), and Deep Strike special rules.

rules.name: Allarus Terminator Armor
rules.description: A more mobile pattern of Terminator Armour rarely used. It provides a 2+ Armour Save and a 4+ Invulnerable save. The Wearer gains Relentless, Bulky (3), Deep Strike and Sprint (1) special rules.

rules.name: Gyrfalcon Jetbike
rules.description:
A unit that is equipped with a Jetbike becomes a Jetbike Type unit. In addition, it gains +1 its Toughness (T) & Wounds (W) Characteristics. A
Gyrfalcon Jetbike is armed with a Lastrum Bolt Cannon.

rules.name: Dawn Eagle Jetbike
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Jetbike becomes a Jetbike type unit. In addition, it gains +1 to its Toughness (T) & Wounds (W) Characteristics. A Dawn Eagle Jetbike is armed with a Hurricane Bolter.

rules.name: Flare Shields
rules.description: A unit equipped with this wargear, reduces the Strength (S) characteristic of any weapons that resolve their hits against the Front Armour (FA) of the equipped unit by 1. If the Attack has the Blast or Large Blast special rule, its strength is reduced by 2.

rules.name: Master of Martial Strategy
rules.description: A model with this Warlord Trait and their Attached unit gains the Counter Attack and Hit & Run special rules.

rules.name: Peerless Warrior
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait treats all Melee type weapons they are equipped with as having the Precision Hits special rule. In addition, increase their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic by 1.

rules.name: Superior Creation
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait gains the Regeneration special rule. A model with this trait is immune to Instant Death.

rules.name: Maiden of Blood
rules.description: A Warlord with this trait gains the Furious Charge and Sudden Strike special rules.

rules.name: Maiden of Resolve
rules.description:
A model with this Warlord trait gains the Feel no Pain (5+) special
and increases their Leadership (LD) characteristic by 1.

rules.name: Maiden of Sorrow
rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of a Warlord with this trait halve their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Voidscale Cloak
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 5+ Invulnerable save and a 3+ Invulnerable save against wounds caused by weapons with the Blast (X) or Spray special rules.

rules.name: Spectra Cloak
rules.description: A unit which includes a model with this wargear may not be targeted for attacks in the Shooting Phase unless it is the closest visible model.

rules.name: Erinyes Jetbike
rules.description: A unit that is equipped with a Jetbike becomes a Jetbike Type unit. In addition, it gains +1 its Toughness (T) & Wounds (W) Characteristics. A Erinyes Jetbike is armed with a Snare Cannon.
